_comment: Quality gate policy, approved by the owner on 2026-11-04 and ENFORCING: a tripped rule or a missing report fails the build. Known accepted findings live in accepted.json with a reason and an expiry date; an expired waiver trips its rule again. Semgrep stays at ERROR and image findings at CRITICAL until the multi-stage build, then HIGH is revisited.

rules.description: Every scan must have produced a report and actually scanned something (files, SBOM components, image targets, ZAP sites).
Any secret found in the target's code or history.
A dependency in the lockfile with a known advisory scoring 9.0 or higher (critical).
A CRITICAL image vulnerability that has a published fix.
A ZAP alert at High risk.
